repos.name: pydantic/pydantic
repos.description: Data validation library for Python, with a Rust core.

runs.notes: First run with the solver in the sandbox; 13 tickets lost to a harness report-parsing bug, fixed afterwards
runs.footnote: The 13 errors are tickets whose test suite the harness wrongly rejected as corrupt before the solver ran: pytest counts subtests in its report totals but writes one entry per test, and the harness read the difference as a truncated report. No patch was judged on those tickets. The bug was fixed in the harness the same day.
